item.title: ראש ממשלת קטאר נוסע לטהראן כאשר מלחמת איראן מתקרבת ל-6 חודשים
item.description: השייח' מוחמד בן עבדולרחמן אל ת'אני היה מתווך מרכזי בסכסוך, גם כשמדינתו האשימה את טהראן במאות התקפות טילים ומזל"טים.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Appears to Be Preparing for a New War With the Houthis
item.description: Analysts say that weeks of Houthi attacks on Saudi targets have brought the kingdom and the Iranian-backed militia to the brink of full-blown conflict, and could open a new front in the Iran war.

item.title: Live Updates: Rescuers Scour Himalayan Valleys for Survivors After Deadly Flood
item.description: Officials said hundreds were killed in Nepal and Tibet in a massive flood. Stunned witnesses described a torrent of debris and water carrying away villages in minutes.

item.title: Man Is Arrested in Fatal Shooting of Mexican Influencer During Livestream
item.description: The authorities accused the man of attacking César Gastélum, a young influencer, during a livestream in Sinaloa this month.

item.title: Where Drones Cannot See, the Ukraine War Is a Deadly Game of Cat and Mouse
item.description: Russian troops are trying to infiltrate the vast, overgrown reservoir basin of a dam they blew up three years ago as Ukrainian soldiers hunt them at close quarters.

item.title: Why Some in Canada Want Out of the F-35 Deal With the U.S.
item.description: A year into a government review of the purchase of as many as 88 F-35s, one premier says buying American warplanes makes no sense in the face of President Trump’s latest tariffs.

item.title: Speed of Nepal’s Flash Floods Likely Overwhelmed Warning System, Experts Say
item.description: Scientists and disaster response researchers said Nepal’s early flood warning system relied on a conventional network of river gauges in this remote region.

item.title: Ratko Mladic, Murderous ‘Butcher of Bosnia,’ Dies at 83
item.description: A general during the Balkan wars of the 1990s, he was convicted in the killing of some 8,000 Muslims at Srebrenica, Europe’s deadliest massacre since World War II.
